notes.title: 《Fantasy Eight Immortals》 Money-Making Guide – Get Rich Quickly and Stay Ahead
notes.content:
The world of the Eight Immortals is bustling with activity, and while you cultivate your skills, why not also make a fortune? Still wondering how to earn your first pot of gold? Don't worry. Making money in Fantasy Eight Immortals is easier than you think. By mastering a few simple money-making strategies, you can quickly become a wealthy and powerful immortal. Let's dive into the secrets of getting rich.
Early Game – Sect Quests: Earn Gold Daily
Once you step onto the path of cultivation, you can join a sect at level 10 and officially become a disciple under the sect leader. From then on, daily sect quests will be your golden opportunity to earn money.
Fun and rewarding quests – Earn a large amount of experience and money. Completing designated quest cycles will grant you double rewards.
Sect points for extra rewards – Accumulate points to exchange for rare items, making money while leveling up.
Simple and profitable – Just a few easy steps each day can help you save up your first fortune and quickly make a name for yourself.
Tip: Completing sect quests in a team can double efficiency and allow you to share insights with fellow immortals.
Mid-Game – Faction Trading and Escort Missions: Wealth Flows In
As your cultivation progresses and you reach a higher level, joining a faction becomes a must. Within your faction, trade runs and escort missions are the golden routes to wealth accumulation.
Buy low, sell high for huge profits – Use faction silver notes to trade goods between cities and experience real economic strategies.
Enjoy beautiful scenery along the way – Travel through picturesque landscapes while making money.
Contribute to your faction for more opportunities – The more you contribute, the more lucrative money-making quests you can unlock.
Tip: Beware of bandits along the trading route. Boost your combat power and bring reliable faction members along to ensure your silver safely reaches its destination.
Late Game – Crafting and Trading: Earn Gold While You Sleep
As you progress into the late game, the demand for goods in the marketplace skyrockets, presenting endless business opportunities. This is your chance to shine and build your economic empire.
Master production skills and turn junk into treasure – Learn alchemy, weapon crafting, and food preparation to continuously produce high-demand items for easy sales and steady profits.
Sell dungeon loot for extra income – Rare equipment and gems dropped from bosses can be sold in the market for huge earnings.
Set up a stall in Kaifeng, the trade hub – The bustling marketplace in Kaifeng is the perfect spot to sell your goods and accumulate wealth.
Tip: Keep an eye on market trends, understand supply and demand, and adjust prices accordingly to maximize profits.
Fun Side Quests: Surprise Rewards and Bonus Income
Beyond the traditional money-making methods, Fantasy Eight Immortals offers engaging side quests that let you earn while having fun.
Investigation quests – Test your detective skills. Follow clues to locate NPCs and complete quests for great rewards, challenging your powers of deduction.
Escort missions – High risk, high reward. Protect a designated NPC to their destination while fending off attackers. Success will bring a hefty amount of gold.
Tip: Escort missions are best done in a team to ensure higher combat strength, a better success rate, and greater rewards.
Money-Making Summary: Get Rich Effortlessly in Fantasy Eight Immortals
Earning money in the world of the Eight Immortals isn’t difficult. Follow the right strategies, and in just a few steps, you can become one of the wealthiest immortals in the game.
Early Game: Sect Quests – Simple tasks for double the rewards
Mid-Game: Faction Trading – Buy low, sell high, and dominate the economy
Late Game: Crafting and Market Trading – A steady stream of wealth
Bonus Quests: Investigation and Escort Missions – Fun ways to earn extra cash
Become a legendary wealthy immortal. Join Fantasy Eight Immortals now and enjoy a prosperous and carefree cultivation journey.

notes.title: Choosing the Wrong Class in Fantasy Eight Immortals Means a Tough Journey
notes.content:
The adorable turn-based cultivation game Fantasy Eight Immortals features fresh and dynamic art styles along with cute Q-version character designs, attracting a large number of turn-based game enthusiasts. With a variety of classes possessing different skill attributes, how can players achieve the ultimate power in the immortal world? Let’s analyze each class one by one.
Race of Power and Burst Damage: Demon Race
A race that may seem evil but only fights against other demons and monsters. They pursue pure strength and explosive power, excelling in physical attacks with formidable offensive capabilities. In the early game, players can focus on training Strength and Vitality, and occasionally enhance Constitution to maintain high damage output while improving survivability. This not only increases endurance in battles but also reduces potion consumption—truly a win-win! This race is the top choice for players who love raw power and burst damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/8b93e4ca30ebf5d519b283b9ed86d82e28847a50.jpg[/img]
Race of Magic and Arcane Arts: Immortal Race
Masters of spell attacks, the Immortal Race can unleash powerful area-of-effect and high-burst magical damage. They serve as key offensive forces in the game, second only to the Demon Race in terms of destructive potential. Early-game players should prioritize training Essence and Vitality, with some investment in Agility. In battles, striking first can often determine victory, and Agility plays a vital role in seizing the initiative!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/64d518e453486b82a28ddb9ed8b98f964a433ba0.jpg[/img]
Race of Speed and Control: Beast Race
Beast Race warriors specialize in sealing techniques, moving swiftly and inflicting debuffs on enemies. Residing in deep forests and mountains, they have developed unparalleled sealing magic through secluded training. In combat or PvP, their influence is undeniable—when a Beast Race fighter chants their incantations and wields their weapon, their enemies find themselves bound and helpless before they even realize it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/9f9c3b98123fa0bcc12cea549c665f98c676652a.jpg[/img]
Race of Healing and Protection: Celestial Race
The Celestial Race represents immortality, compassion, and enlightenment—the ultimate goal of cultivation. They excel in various healing arts, offering support and bolstering the attack and survival capabilities of their teammates. As an indispensable part of any team, Celestial beings shine in group battles, providing essential support roles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/9f9c3b98123fa0bcc12cea549c665f98c676652a.jpg[/img]
Race of Darkness and Cunning: Human Race
Created by Nuwa, humans dwell upon the earth, valuing emotions and loyalty. They excel in using hidden weapons and poisonous techniques, causing continuous damage while weakening enemies' offensive and defensive capabilities. As the most cunning class among the Eight Immortals, they strike from the shadows with deadly precision. Their sustained damage skills leave enemies powerless, making them feared assassins of the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/c932acc54f4381b5b37c86271bbd2458c8bc9538.jpg[/img]
The highly anticipated 2D turn-based Q-version game Fantasy Eight Immortals offers an endless array of exciting gameplay features! With its romantic and refreshing game world and intriguing storyline, countless immortals are inviting you to explore this charming and whimsical realm together!

notes.title: 集思广益之玩家守护攻略篇
notes.content:
守护，也可以叫召唤兽，宝宝。与你一起征战世界的陪伴者。现阶段版本，守护分为“宝宝”和“稀有”、“神兽”三大类别。宝宝：资质上限一般，携带等级段上成长一般。稀有：资质上限优秀，携带等级段上成长高于宝宝。神兽：资质上限强悍，0级携带，成长随进阶增长。
前期守护你只需要注意的是，携带等级和成长上限就可以，其他都不是大问题，毕竟都是过渡宠物，正式玩宠物建议80级开始，所以前期获得的宠物资源可以留着，比如：技能书，变异丹之类的。

 35级之前新手送的野猪用着就好，平A至死，方得圆满。

  35级，可以考虑去开封塔五层抓捕一只“鬼魂”使用轮回丹，洗出来高级狂暴和高级夜袭就可以用了，不用刻意追求满成长，毕竟过渡期不是很长。也可以不用考虑换宝宝，继续小野猪平A至死。这个等级没有什么好的法宠推荐，因为20级的水灵，25级的幽灵，30级的花精都是单秒法术，不怎么强力，还浪费真气，所以，继续平A吧。

  40级，想换了洗一只玉门关的女飞贼，带高级连击就可以用了，但是不是很推荐，毕竟成长就比鬼魂宝宝多了0.004。

  50级，可以考虑更换炎火岭的“炽火鸟”了，携带技能赤火流星，秒三技能，可以大幅提升练级速度，还是比较推荐的。

  60级，首推蟠桃园野怪偶遇的攻宠“偷桃小圣”、法宠可以考虑更换为“蟠桃仙”，也可以继续使用炽火鸟。

  70级，可以考虑卧龙湾的“蚌精”法宠，但是80级了才是法宠正主，所以可换可不换。

  80级，强推稀有宠物“画蛊术师”，试炼窟二层野怪偶遇可抓捕。

  此阶段就可以考虑合宠了，合宠具体操作见合宠攻略。

  90级，强推稀有攻宠“虎妖”，试炼窟三层野怪偶遇可抓捕。法宠可换试炼窟四层的“黄眉怪”，和画蛊术师区别就是成长高了，但是如果画蛊术师你合宠合出来更好的，就完全没必要换黄眉。

  100级，福寿山一层的“独角兽”攻宠正主，特殊技能“恭行天罚”攻击利器，类似某回合游戏的“善恶”技能。

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/0c472080a258a58e0abab5b675f7f31d373dd9cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 经典回归，重磅来袭！STEAM《梦幻八仙》重磅上线~
notes.content:
金蛇狂舞，新春至，震撼来袭，数十载的陪伴，《梦幻八仙》为何让人如此沉迷？继续阅读，我们在此为你揭晓！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/02ba0349f5b5c19be0b1b890b25c68236804d7fc.jpg[/img]

[b]【战场多变，掌控天气】[/b]
《梦幻八仙》独创“天气系统”，将六种天气现象引入战场，让战斗充满变数。随着天气的转换，不同职业门派将获得不同加成。小心踏入“雷区”，可能会有激雷劈下来哦！但别担心，也许倒霉的是你的对手呢~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/d755c4a8f52ae3a42d16f8e458de0326659b9e1a.jpg[/img]

[b]【修仙飞行，真·仙境】[/b]
众多游戏自称能修仙，但真正做到飞行仙境，体验成仙之乐的又有几款？《醉八仙》独创“飞行修仙”系统，踏入八仙境界，拥有自己的坐骑，即使是基础的小毛驴，也能享受飞天的乐趣！不仅能在天空中自由飞翔，还能避开地面上那些虎视眈眈的怪物哦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/a408d7cb84131b49c5481be2bdedadf7e5f21213.jpg[/img]

[b]【活动丰富，乐趣十足】[/b]
有时候玩游戏也会感到无聊，可能是因为可做的事情太少。《梦幻八仙》就不用担心这个问题~从周一到周日，丰富的活动安排，多样化的机制，让你轻松摆脱游戏荒！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/bf6a2816c7b9137ab9ed41cf6a81a50b49ed81a1.jpg[/img]

想要征服妖魔，可以参与门派入侵；想要热血竞技，可以参与比武大会；想要财源滚滚，可以参与劫富济贫；想要休闲娱乐，可以参与醉八仙旅游团~各种需求，《梦幻八仙》超多活动都能满足，带你找回游戏的乐趣！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/d755c4a8f52ae3a42d16f8e458de0326659b9e1a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 《梦幻八仙》集思广益新手小提示
notes.content:
1、自动遇怪的快捷键为Alt+Y，主要是在A和B点之间来回往返，直到你点击其他地方。
所以你要去野外自动遇怪，就需要先站在A点，然后鼠标点到B点，期间就可以Alt+Y，这样就实现了在A到B点的自动遇怪了，所以举一反三而言，也可以在小地图上长距离自动遇怪。

2、角色加点，30级前是可以在桃源镇村长处免费重置的，所以建议还是全力加点，砍怪到29级了去重置一下，可以按推荐加点，也可以按职业特性推荐加点。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/db2907d0608e35e78dd2794d62f0b8f12f69aa37.jpg[/img]

3、守护的选择，前期不用考虑宝宝带什么，就是系统送的野猪，带着就可以了，虽然确实很慢，但是起码前期神兽级的存在呢，可以选择35级了去开封塔五层抓一直鬼魂用轮回丹洗洗，或者等到50级了去炎火岭抓一只炽火鸟带着。

4、双倍经验和四倍经验每周有8个小时，妥善使用，使用后不但经验暴涨，同时还能屏蔽验证的答题窗口。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/b6b93c6c1623076341a3efb6b07fed0dcc3170dc.jpg[/img]

5、升级怎么快，少做支线任务多刷开封塔，记得补满状态在进哦~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/99e2b284777319b0691199e6126ae939b2fc7eae.jpg[/img]

6、宠物技能书如何获取，30级以后多多参与各种每日活动，具体见活动栏提示。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/797ad3e4fa6321cd55ddba8a4c44d7e51c2fbada.jpg[/img]

7、洗宠物变宝宝的是轮回丹，让宠物变异的是碧幽丹，提升宠物资质的叫彩虹丹，改变宠物样子的是兽魂果。

8、新手礼包15级送飞天符，可以记录城内坐标，达到快速飞行过去的效果，初始只有30次飞行机会，每周二、四晚间6:30-8:30的活动怪出增加卷，可以参与活动获取。

想获取更多小技巧，快关注梦幻八仙新闻，或在讨论贴中留言吧，欢迎各位仙友投稿，祝仙友们玩的愉快~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/e2d4a258c1377188ba5f970546b6a921f87cd182.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 不会自动挂机？看完这篇攻略，《梦幻八仙》挂机问题一次性全解决！
notes.content:
作为一款经典老牌回合制，《醉八仙》又怎么能没有完善的挂机系统呢？新入坑的萌新们要是找不到自动挂机的好方法，不用担心~看完这篇攻略，让你轻松挂机升级，上班摸鱼两不误！
【问题一】：为什么要挂机？

在《梦幻八仙》中，挂机往往会有许多的惊喜~不论是前期攒经验升级，或是掉落材料、图纸打造装备，都是离不开挂机刷怪的。除此之外，还有许多烹饪材料和一二级药都是可以通过挂机获取哒~

 

【问题二】：去哪里挂机比较好？

《梦幻八仙》挂机刷怪一般分为三种情况。

1. 刷塔挂机

升级前期，玩家可以选择前往开封南的开封塔组队挂机刷怪。别忘了挂机刷怪前去门口的道士处领取任务哦~任务完成后，不但可以获得丰厚的经验，同时还有概率获得珍稀阵法礼包。

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/f95a6c46b48142a4ddabd7fff6aded2ac25931bf.jpg[/img]

2. 刷野挂机

不知道干什么的时候，刷野挂机准没错！仙友们可以自行挑选符合等级的对应地图刷怪。在对应地图，可以掉落对应装备所需要的装备材料、装备图纸，以及各种烹饪材料和一二级药，囤货必备哦~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/28ff0a2cf284c01542b8e314bffc603b7a58b8fc.png[/img]

3. 活动挂机

当仙友们成长到一定的水平之后，就可以轻松参与活动，挂机击杀活动怪啦~《梦幻八仙》的活动多多，精彩连连，而且经常会掉落各种珍稀材料、商城道具，真真不容错过哦！

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/73bfa8058f9e8c993fa2a724f154da7880c74d60.jpg[/img]

【问题三】：如何自动挂机？

当你要开始挂机时，可以打开当前小地图，点击离自己较远的一点，让角色开始走动后，再按下[ALT+Y]，就能在地图两点间自动巡逻遇怪啦！

 

【问题四】：如何屏蔽防外挂验证？

为了避免某些不良玩家挂机开挂，在《梦幻八仙》里设置了防外挂验证，致力于给全体玩家带来公平公正的游戏环境。

不过不用担心，防外挂验证也是可以通过正规手段屏蔽的哦~赶紧往下看吧！

1. 领取多倍经验

当开始挂机时，玩家可以前往开封NPC领双人范统处（开封 233，141）领取多倍经验，不论是双倍、四倍，都可以哦~拥有多倍经验后，外挂验证就会被屏蔽啦！

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/ab0df6b18bac3f3e533161c54edeae3697c1de76.jpg[/img]

2. 如意锁——无限回合

除了领取多倍经验外，在游戏里还有一个小道具，不但可以屏蔽外挂验证，还可以让你无限回合挂机哦~此等宝贝就是——如意锁！

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/9c4be7835a25f5f724cb5c766831e526db88d369.png[/img]

使用如意锁后，玩家将可在如意锁持续的120分钟期间（可叠加时间）屏蔽外挂验证，还能拥有无限回合，再也不用发愁挂机不顺啦~轻松挂机打怪升级，想怎么玩就怎么玩！悄悄告诉你们，这个小道具除了在商城购买之外，游戏活动也可掉落，同时官方也会经常当做小福利来赠送哦！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333732/a09a2e578792bdbd5f91d365453ef9d5d3a6a36b.png[/img]
